column3: The utility usage charge is an immediate harness commit, not persistence: deferred
column4: a deferred commit is stored by the next commit that touches pi.usage or after settings.progress.persistWithinMs (about 1 s); the next pi.usage commit is the next model response, usually later than that, so deferring would rarely fold the row and would risk losing the charge on a crash
column5: pi-durable session.js #deferral returns undefined without persistence.kind "deferred"; plugins/compact/summary.ts chargeUsage passes no options; spec 13-always-on states one immediate journal row per utility response, two commits on the utility path like pi's own
